weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天蠍座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天蠍座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，你今晚是否為你的家庭準備了特別的東西？如果是這樣，你可能會為如何獲得烹飪或出租能力而感到煩惱。放下那些煩惱！晚上一定會讓每個人都感到愉快，包括你。期待各式各樣的難忘體驗。盡你最大的努力，擁抱你開朗的天性，專注於享受這一刻。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, are you planning something special for your household this evening? If so, you might find yourself fretting over how your culinary or hosting abilities will be received. Let go of those worries! The night promises to be enjoyable for everyone, including you. Expect a memorable experience all around. Just put forth your best effort, embrace your cheerful nature, and focus on enjoying the moment.

taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you might find yourself at a cozy get-together in your community, if the opportunity arises. If you're in a relationship, expect to enjoy this event alongside your partner. For those who are single, you could reconnect with familiar faces and even meet some new ones. One of these newcomers might catch your eye, possibly someone a bit more seasoned in life. So, take a breather, unwind, and embrace the joy of the moment!

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, expect a variety of conversations to unfold. You might receive a call from an older family member, possibly your parents. While the chat may lean towards the casual side rather than deep discussions, it will still be a pleasant experience. Later on, you may reach out to friends or colleagues to share in the joy of some exciting news.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you might find yourself waiting for a call that doesn’t come, which could stir up some concern. Don’t hesitate to take the initiative and reach out instead. Your friend may simply have lost track of time or been swamped with their responsibilities. Rest assured, you’re still on their mind. A call from you will surely brighten their day. After your chat, consider taking a stroll around your neighborhood to clear your head.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, financial concerns might be weighing heavily on your thoughts. You may find that a payment you anticipated hasn't come through yet. Additionally, a project you've committed to might be taking longer than you initially expected, causing a hold-up in the funds you were counting on. Remember, the important takeaway is "delayed." It's not a permanent setback, just a temporary pause. Stay patient and try not to let anxiety consume your time!

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你與朋友聯繫的衝動是顯而易見的，但情況可能與你的期望不符。你可能會發現自己受到未完成的任務或其他義務的束縛。但是，不要灰心！仍然有享受的機會。首先處理所有必要的雜務，以清除您的日程安排，您可能會發現您仍然可以參與您設想的樂趣。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, your urge to connect with friends is palpable, but circumstances may not align with your expectations. You might find yourself held back by unfinished tasks or other obligations. However, don’t lose heart! There’s still a chance for enjoyment. Tackle any necessary chores first to clear your schedule, and you may just find that you can still partake in the fun you envisioned.

libra.horoscope_en: Libra, you might feel a bit unsure about a professional aspiration you've been pursuing. It's natural to question whether your efforts have been in vain, but try to shake off those doubts. There are many unseen factors at play that you haven't yet discovered. Once you catch wind of these updates, you'll realize you're still very much in the game. Instead of letting work consume your thoughts today, take some time to unwind. Tomorrow could bring the clarity you need.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Have you been dedicating a significant amount of time to mastering a particular skill, Scorpio? Today, you may find things feeling a bit more perplexing than usual. A new idea might surface that seems unclear at first. Instead of getting stuck trying to figure it out, shift your focus to something else. The clarity you seek will likely strike you unexpectedly. Remember to be patient.

sagittarius.horoscope: 你是否發現自己在今天醒來時正在思考一個朦朧的夢？如果是這種情況，請不要擔心檢索每個細節。宇宙可能只想讓你抓住它的碎片。專注於你可以回憶的片段；它們可能具有意義或洞察力。當某些事情觸發你的記憶時，你甚至可能會發現清晰度。請記住，這只是一個夢想，不要讓它吞噬你的思想。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Did you find yourself pondering a hazy dream upon waking today? If that's the case, don't stress about retrieving every detail. It might be that the universe intends for you to only grasp fragments of it. Focus on the snippets you can recall; they may hold meaning or insight. You might even find clarity later when something triggers your memory. Remember, it's just a dream—don't let it consume your thoughts.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，摩羯座，你可能會發現自己全神貫注於法律問題。您的擔憂可能會放大超出實際規模的特定挑戰。退一步，嘗試以更清晰的視角評估情況。如果可以的話，請尋找知識淵博的人為您提供真實的詳細資訊。當你意識到你一直在誇大問題時，你可能會感到一種解脫感。 現在，專注於放鬆和擁抱更無憂無慮的態度。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you might find yourself preoccupied with legal issues. It's possible that your worries are amplifying a particular challenge beyond its actual size. Take a step back and try to assess the situation with a clearer perspective. If you can, seek out someone knowledgeable who can provide you with the real details. You'll likely feel a sense of relief when you realize you've been exaggerating the problem. For now, focus on unwinding and embracing a more carefree attitude.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find yourself in need of assistance or guidance. Embrace the idea of reaching out; there's no shame in seeking support. While you often take pride in your resourcefulness and self-sufficiency, remember that it's usually others who come to you for help. Recognizing when to ask for help is not a weakness, but rather a true strength. Reflect on this.

pisces.horoscope_en: Are you sensing some hesitation from your partner about dedicating time to you today, Pisces? Initially, this might sting, as they may feel a pull to prioritize family commitments. While you might not get the full day together as you envisioned, there’s still a chance to connect. In the meantime, take this opportunity to unwind and pamper yourself.
